evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: So this is what to expect when you're expecting put onto an app?

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: That peace of mind when you go to the doctor.

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: But you would think that the patient — in order to have that peace of mind that they would get going to the doctor's office, where the doctor looks at them, checks the blood pressure, checks the weight, and says “you're looking good,” thumbs up — you would think that they would want that kind of reassurance each time that the doctor gets the measurements in order to have that increased peace of mind.

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: Does that mean when the doctor's getting this data from the kit, are they communicating at all with the patient and saying, “Hey you're looking, the numbers are good.” Or are they just saying, by exception, they'll communicate if the numbers don't look good?

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: On his behalf, I think the difference is, they're harmonizing the data and looking for irrelevant data points before the doctor even sees it. If the patient has to look at the data...

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: So the doctors are your customers?

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: The doctor is paying you for access to the data about their patients?

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: How do they make more money?

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: What do you make of the existential risk of the insurance companies changing their compensation plans and methods so that now they're not getting paid one lump sum for the whole pregnancy. And they're getting paid per appointment, that kind of thing.

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: How much revenue have you generated to date?

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: How much of the $3.5 million do you have committed so far?

evidence_registry.speaker: Phil
evidence_registry.text: Well, I really like what you're doing. Making great progress. I feel like you've attacked this problem in a smart way by starting with the studies to prove the efficacy, to prove what you're doing, because you know that that's what they're going to require, your customers are going to require. So I think you've approached it in a smart way. I'd like to participate.
